Core Civic Engineering Pillars

Bridging the gap between legal statutes, civil engineering blueprints, and daily Mumbai commuting.

PILLAR 01 — STATUTE

Motor Vehicles Act 1988 & 2019

Full textual and situational breakdown of Sections 112, 115, 129, 134, 184, 185, and 194. Learn exact legal procedures, rights during vehicle inspection, and compoundable offence protocols.

PILLAR 02 — ENGINEERING

IRC Road Geometry & Markings

Indian Roads Congress guidelines for lane widths, stop lines, pedestrian zebra crossing zones, yellow box junctions, and speed breaker dimensions for Indian urban roads.

PILLAR 03 — COMPUTATION

Automated Challan Computation

Interactive fine calculator modeling compoundable vs non-compoundable penalties, repeat violations, driving license suspension thresholds, and digital e-challan dispute procedures.

PILLAR 04 — EMERGENCY

Good Samaritan Protection (Sec 134A)

Comprehensive legal protections for citizens aiding road crash victims, Supreme Court guidelines, exemption from civil/criminal liability, and golden hour hospital admission mandates.

PILLAR 05 — MUNICIPAL

Mumbai Specific Civic Rules

Local Coastal Road speed profiles, Eastern Freeway restrictions, Bandra-Worli Sea Link regulations, silence zone noise pollution bylaws, and odd-even lane merging logic.

PILLAR 06 — TELEMETRY

Simulator Bridge Integration

Real-time data synchronization with Mumbai Traffic Hero 3D. Every traffic violation committed in the simulator logs straight to CivicLogic for immediate post-drive debriefs.
